title: Amazingly Aromatic British Prune Scones
description: These British prune scones are a delicious and aromatic brunch dish featuring prunes and a cheese pull, made with a yeast-based dough and halal-friendly ingredients. The scones are perfect for a weekend brunch or breakfast gathering.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Add the chopped prunes, grated cheese, eggs, and milk to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll the dough into a circle that is about 1 inch thick.
Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out the scones.
Place the scones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the scones in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
